Linux admin/API/node commands cross-compiled only; Linux Secret Service protocol fixtures do not validate a real Linux keyring

Native forwarding uses only loopback synthetic HTTP backends and explicit admission/secret fixtures. No production route/funding/lease gate, SDK compatibility certification, real engine stop, content E2E, paid model or billable usage evidence.

Three native text profiles only; no cross-dialect conversion, tools, media or Sub2API code extraction. Prior frontend TS/build receipts are reused after exact source/output/log hash checks; both current browser journeys rerun with the current native binary.

Order capacity is not a wallet, payment authorization, route/lease admission or GPU release. Qualifications and READY/usage/rental facts are explicitly synthetic; production qualified-source generation and integration remain pending. Legacy budget rows remain fully held, including old RELEASED/CONSUMED states.

First R018 full run: 221 passed / 1 failed. Generic metadata Queue.Claim selected an unsupported DELIVER_EXECUTION_LEASE task created by earlier API fixtures. Both claiming and exhausted-job updates now filter supported kinds; stronger assertions preserve unsupported task state/tries. Failed logs and media remain archived; no task is deleted or marked complete to obtain a pass.

Verifier-only authenticated native lease delivery; immutable original claim and safe event, exact original scoped key/order/funds/qualification/hold/input/owner rechecks. Claim never ACKs an attempt, completes delivery tasks, decrypts input, submits an engine, renews, reassigns or bills. Production independent pins/kernel plans, actual device input/manifest transport, native CLI durable execution commands, real kernels/usage/channel, E2E/LP/PE/rental and full acceptance remain open. R016 cleanup timing risk remains unresolved.
